zh.title: 長榮航空12月1日起開闢桃園直飛德里航線每週5班
zh.summary: 長榮航空12月1日開航桃園至德里；每週5班並採用A330-300執飛。
body: 長榮航空將於12月1日起開闢桃園直飛印度德里航線，每週二、三、五、六、日提供5個往返班次，並採用空中巴士A330-300機型執飛。長榮航空成為目前唯一直飛印度的台灣航空公司，該航線自2020年COVID-19疫情期間中斷至今。
駐印度代表陳牧民於8月13日接見長榮航空派駐德里的機場經理劉景嘉，瞭解直飛航線的準備進度。陳牧民表示，桃園直飛德里航線開通後能將航程時間縮短為6個小時，便利兩地商務、觀光及人員往來交流。

en.title: EVA Air to Launch Direct Taoyuan-Delhi Flights on December 1
en.summary: EVA Air will open direct Taoyuan-Delhi flights on December 1 with five weekly flights using A330-300s.
body: EVA Air will launch direct flights between Taoyuan and Delhi, India, starting December 1, operating five weekly flights on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays using Airbus A330-300 aircraft. The carrier will become the only Taiwan-based airline currently offering direct service to India, which had been suspended since 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Taiwan representative to India Chen Mu-min met with EVA Air Delhi airport manager Liu Jing-jia on August 13 to review preparation progress for the new route. According to Chen, the direct route will reduce travel time between Taoyuan and Delhi to six hours, facilitating bilateral business, tourism, and official exchanges.

zh.title: 達美航空預計於2027年開航奧斯汀直飛巴黎航線
zh.summary: 達美航空規劃2027年開航奧斯汀直飛巴黎航線；便利德州中部旅客連接全球。
body: 達美航空（Delta Air Lines）宣布規劃於2027年正式開航連結美國奧斯汀與法國巴黎的直飛航線服務。該航空公司確認，此項全新直飛航班營運計畫預計於2027年起開始實施。
達美航空表示，這條全新的奧斯汀至巴黎直飛航線，將能讓德州中部的旅客比以往更加輕鬆且便利地前往世界各地的目的地。
據 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空預估這項規劃於2027年啟動的航線，將有助於強化奧斯汀地區旅客與全球網絡之間的飛航連接。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Plans Nonstop Austin to Paris Flights Launching in 2027
en.summary: Delta Air Lines will link Austin and Paris with nonstop flights launching in 2027.
body: Delta Air Lines has confirmed plans to link Austin and Paris with nonstop flights launching in 2027. The airline announced the new service to expand direct flight options between the two cities.
The carrier stated that the route between Austin and Paris will make it easier than ever for passengers originating from Central Texas to connect to various destinations around the world.
As reported by Simple Flying, Delta Air Lines expects to launch the new route in 2027, establishing nonstop air service connecting Central Texas with Paris.
The legacy carrier noted that the 2027 launch will enhance global access for travelers flying out of Central Texas.
